pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: NOW... HOW WILL YOU REACT...?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SHINOMIYA THOUGHT FOR AN INSTANT...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: BUT WHAT WENT THROUGH HER MIND WAS NO ORDINARY PROCESS OF THOUGHT!

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: HE'S ATTACKED ME...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: BY REVEALING THAT HE WANTS TO SEE THE MOVIE, HE'S LEFT THE CHOICE OF WHETHER TO GO OR NOT UP TO ME.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: A FINE COUNTER- ATTACK..

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I Have The OPTION OF REFUSING HIM,

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BUT THAT WOULD RENDER ALL I'VE DONE UP TO THIS POINT MEANING- LESS...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: ALL I'VE DONE.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: CAREFULLY PREPARING A FAKE PRIZE...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SLUPPING UTRINTO FUJIWARA'S MAILBOX

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: AND FINDING AMOVIEON A WEEKEND ONONEOF HIS RARE BREAKS!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF I REFUSE HIM HERE, WITH HIS MENTAL WEAKNESS

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: HE MAY VERY WELL NEVER INVITE ME TO A MOVIE AGAIN.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: AS A WOMAN, I CANNOT ALLOW THAT!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THAT IS NOT AN OPTION!!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I CANNOT RETREAT!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YOU'RE RIGHT.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I DO SORT OF BELIEVE IT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BUT I WAS HOPING SOMEONE WOULD GIVE ME A SINCERE INVITATION TO SEE IT...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SHINOMIYA USED THE SKILL "FEIGNING INNOCENCE!!"

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: ONE OF THE SECRET TECHNIQUES PASSED DOWN FROM FATHER TO CHILD IN THE SHINOMIYA FAMILY!

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: AGAINST THIS CAREFULLY CALCULATED EXPRESSION AND SUDDEN CHANGE IN VOICE, EVEN THE HEART OF A GOD WOULD BE SET AFLUTTER!

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SHIROGANE'S THOUGHTS WERE THROWN INTO DISARRAY!!
